escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Mbappé & Yamal Exposed Haaland’s Fake Injury Instantly…, by SportFiction, with over 14 million views.
In second place, لما نجيب اخرنا منها ومن فرهدتها 😂, by Omar kotb, with over 18 million views.
And number one: Our new pediatrician taught me this, by Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with over 31 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
